name: web/Rate limiting absent burst acceptance
description: [medium] Proves absence of rate limiting on a sensitive endpoint: five rapid identical requests all return 200 (no 429/throttle anywhere in the burst) = OTP/login/token brute surfaces open (OWASP API4). Keywords: rate limiting brute force otp verification throttling api abuse burst. ctrl: throttled endpoint 429s mid-burst -> not falsified. base_url = sensitive endpoint (OTP verify / login / token check).
